doctrine.highest_value_missing_asset: one externally witnessed result showing that Nocturnal helps a real analyst, fact-checker, steward, researcher, or journalist reconstruct an evolving information state better than the normal workflow

pilot_protocol.preferred_case_type: closed/public information-manipulation or evolving-claim case with lawful public-source evidence
pilot_protocol.forbidden_shortcut: Do not create or target private-person surveillance, harassment, or punitive identity dossiers to manufacture pilot value.

portfolio_collisions.TWNIC: One proposal per applying legal entity: run whole-portfolio plus host bake-off before reserving the slot.
portfolio_collisions.NLnet: First-time applicant should focus; Policy Lab, Citation Engine, Refinery and Nocturnal compete for the first-grant slot.
portfolio_collisions.MODA: Very high collision: only pursue if a qualified information-services company plus Taiwan nonprofit already want the prescribed open-model/AI-Agent field deployment. Do not warp Nocturnal to fit.
portfolio_collisions.Tech Policy Press: One personal thematic application: Nocturnal may lead while Policy Lab/Citation Engine support the candidate narrative.
portfolio_collisions.ICWSM_WebSci: Protect novelty and overlap; one pilot can support both but manuscripts/demo contributions must remain distinct.
portfolio_collisions.FIJ_Pulitzer: Actual journalist/investigation partnership decides whether Nocturnal is supporting infrastructure; the software is not the applicant.

routes.contribution_view: Current-state reconstruction, source provenance, correction/supersession history and duplicate-check reduction for information-manipulation analysis
routes.gate: G4 partner willingness and a bounded public/closed case. Start with a no-cost or clearly scoped evaluation; no funding is implied. Pilot must measure workflow delta rather than ask the partner to validate marketing claims.

routes.contribution_view: Evolving-claim reconstruction, correction consistency, provenance and repeated-check reduction
routes.gate: G4 partner willingness and one bounded public case. TFC is a fact-checking organization, not a grant programme; no financial award is implied. Measure analyst workflow and correctness deltas against their normal process.

routes.opportunity: bounded external Nocturnal public-data stewardship pilot
routes.contribution_view: Public-data provenance, versioning, durable public memory and open-technology stewardship
routes.gate: G4 partner willingness and a concrete public-data/public-memory use case. OCF is a collaboration/fiscal-sponsorship ecosystem, not a guaranteed funding source; keep the first pilot narrow and measurable.

routes.opportunity: Internet Freedom Fund — Nocturnal project route
routes.contribution_view: Applied internet-freedom technology/research for reconstructing information state under censorship, source disappearance and manipulation
routes.gate: G3/G4 prove a concrete internet-freedom user problem and preferably partner/pilot demand; generic better-news positioning is insufficient. Awards are US$10k-900k for up to 24 months, with ideal requests US$50k-200k for 6-12 months. Reverify eligibility, surveillance exclusion, contracting/IP and exact project category before FIRE.

routes.organization: Taiwan Administration for Digital Industries / MODA
routes.opportunity: 115年 AI生態系實證應用徵案 — Nocturnal partner route
routes.contribution_view: Public-interest information-integrity field application only if an existing qualified consortium genuinely needs Nocturnal
routes.gate: G1 requires a Taiwan-registered eligible information-services business (J582/J62/J63/K6699) jointly applying with a Taiwan nonprofit foundation/association and proof of collaboration. The official public event page requires domain open AI models and AI-Agent application deployment. Do not rebuild Nocturnal into a generic model/agent platform. Thread research reported a very large ceiling, but the accessible official page does not state the award ceiling; verify the application guide before economics.

routes.opportunity: Demo paper — Nocturnal interactive information-state reconstruction
routes.contribution_view: Interactive current-state reconstruction with provenance and dispute/correction/supersession history
routes.gate: G4 obtain one credible external pilot first; G2 demo paper is up to 3 pages and single-blind. Preserve contribution novelty against any WebSci manuscript and do not convert internal product tests into user-impact claims.

routes.contribution_view: Empirical test of whether correction-aware current-state reconstruction improves understanding versus conventional article timelines/search
routes.gate: G4 pilot evidence first; then define a genuine empirical research contribution. The official full-paper deadline is firm. Protect manuscript novelty and overlap with ICWSM demo/publications.

routes.contribution_view: Asia-Pacific Internet-enabled public-interest resilience if a registered organization owns the deployment
routes.gate: 2026 concept-note round is closed. Individuals are not eligible; an organization registered in the APNIC service region must lead. Prior/current published tiers are up to US$20k/50k/75k. Wait for the official 2027 call and do not invent its deadline or scope.

overrides.contribution_view: How censorship, disappearing sources, edits, denials, corrections and contradictory reporting change the recoverable documented state over time
overrides.gate: G1/G5/G6: ICRP is full-time; full-time student applicants need departmental support or an accepted opt-out justification. A host is not required at Stage 1, though one strengthens the concept; a host is required before contracting. Applicant/affiliates/host cannot be engaged in development, production, sale or marketing of surveillance software/hardware/associated technology. Research must address restrictive information environments and include a technical component/output; pure advocacy/policy is poor fit. Review OTF contracting, IP/work-product and data/privacy terms before submission/acceptance.
overrides.reason: Focused Nocturnal audit adds the exact research thesis, full-time/student-support gate, Stage-1 host semantics and surveillance-affiliation exclusion.

overrides.gate: G1 requires a legally registered entity (company, association, nonprofit, research or academic institution). Each applying organization may submit only one proposal, so run a whole-portfolio plus host bake-off before reserving the slot. Maximum subsidy is NT$1.5M/project. Do not count institutional funding as personal cash.
overrides.reason: Focused Nocturnal audit verifies legal-entity gate, one-proposal-per-organization scarcity, exact deadline and NT$1.5M ceiling.

overrides.contribution_view: Open current-state/provenance/public-memory infrastructure only if the proposed work is natively libre/open
overrides.gate: Calls reopen Sep 3. First proposal request range is €5k-50k; software/hardware/content funded by NLnet must be libre/open and open standards used where possible. NLnet explicitly advises first-time applicants to focus because only one first grant can be selected. Run Policy Lab vs Citation Engine vs Refinery vs Nocturnal bake-off before writing multiple proposals.
overrides.reason: Focused Nocturnal audit verifies Sep 3 reopening, Nov 3 deadline, €5k-50k first request, open-output requirements and first-grant focus constraint.

overrides.contribution_view: Nocturnal-led personal theme on digital power/information integrity with Policy Lab and Citation Engine as supporting evidence
overrides.gate: G2 requires CV, <=2-page cover letter, publicly accessible attributed prior publications and two professional references. US$10k stipend, remote/part-time for 12 months. International applicants are welcome. Keep marginal effort capped because selection is highly competitive; one applicant narrative, not three project applications.
overrides.reason: Focused Nocturnal audit converts the generic fellowship fit into one personal Nocturnal-led thematic application and preserves the low-effort rule.

overrides.contribution_view: Supporting evidence/reconstruction infrastructure for a journalist-led investigation
overrides.gate: FIJ regular grants are for freelance journalists, staff reporters or media outlets and provide up to US$10k. Nocturnal/software owner is not the applicant merely because the tool fits. Proceed only with a real journalist/investigation lead; otherwise skip the current cycle.
overrides.reason: Focused Nocturnal audit verifies Sep 14 ET deadline, up-to-US$10k regular grant and reporter/media applicant gate.

overrides.contribution_view: Supporting technical evidence layer for journalist plus CSO/academic AI-accountability collaboration
overrides.gate: The 2026 AI Accountability Collaborations call is closed. It required an interdisciplinary partnership including at least one journalist and one CSO/academic member, South/Southeast Asia project basis, and offered up to US$20k for 4-6 month projects. Watch the next round; do not manufacture a deadline or reserve it for Nocturnal absent a real investigation/partner.
overrides.reason: Focused Nocturnal audit replaces generic grant posture with the current closed-round, partner-first AI Accountability Collaboration semantics.

overrides.opportunity: Common Research Framework for Situational Awareness on Information Integrity
overrides.contribution_view: Technical information-integrity component or future third-party funding candidate; not a direct-lead assumption
overrides.gate: The call funds one €6M proposal at 100% over 24-30 months and requires at least 60% redistribution to third parties. It targets research institutions, civil society, fact-checkers, technology providers and other stakeholders, but direct consortium/country eligibility and later third-party geographic rules must be verified. Do not assume a Taiwan-based individual can lead or receive cascade funding. Seek consortium/component visibility rather than building an EU proposal from scratch.
overrides.reason: Focused audit upgrades the thread watch with official €6M/100%/60%-redistribution/deadline facts while preserving eligibility uncertainty.
